questions.q_en: PQR is inscribed in a circle with center O. PO is produced to meet QR at U and the circle at S, and PT QR, where T lies between Q and U. If Q = 70° and R = 55°, then what is the measure [in degrees] of TPS?
questions.q_hi: PQR को केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त में अंकित किया गया है। PO को QR से U पर तथा वृत्त को S पर मिलाने के लिए बढ़ाया गया है, तथा PT QR है, जहाँ T, Q और U के बीच में स्थित है। यदि Q = 70° और R = 55° है, तो TPS का माप [डिग्री में] क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
Given that
PT ⊥ QR
∠Q = 70 ̊, ∠R = 55 ̊
O is the centre of circle
Then; with formula
∠TPS = ∠Q - ∠R
=70 – 55 = 15 ̊
2nd method: [In detail]
In △PQR, ∠Q = 70, ∠R = 55 ̊
Hen ∠P = 180 – 70 – 55 = 55 ̊
And, in △PQT, ∠T= 90 ̊, ∠Q = 70 ̊
Hen ∠QPT=180 – 90 – 70 = 20 ̊
Now, join SR to form △PRS
Where, ∠PRS = 90 ̊ [semicircle]
∠PSR =∠PQR [same arc]
∴∠RPS = 90 – 70 = 20 ̊
Now;
∠TPS = ∠QPR ∠RPS ∠QPT
= 55 – 20 – 20 = 15 ̊
questions.solution_hi:
दिया गया है कि
PT ⊥ QR
∠Q = 70 ̊, ∠R = 55 ̊
O वृत्त का केंद्र है
तो; सूत्र के साथ
∠TPS = ∠Q - ∠R
=70 – 55 = 15 ̊
दूसरी विधि: [विस्तार से]
△PQR में, ∠Q = 70, ∠R = 55 ̊
तो ∠P = 180 – 70 – 55 = 55 ̊
और, △PQT में, ∠T= 90 ̊, ∠Q = 70 ̊
तो ∠QPT=180 – 90 – 70 = 20 ̊
अब, SR को जोड़कर △PRS बनाएँ
जहाँ, ∠PRS = 90 ̊ [semicircle]
∠PSR =∠PQR [same arc]
∴∠RPS = 90 – 70 = 20 ̊
अब;
∠TPS = ∠QPR - ∠RPS - ∠QPT
= 55 – 20 – 20 = 15 ̊
